name: Lightfused Umbral Tin
tooltip:
Lightfused Umbral Tin
5 yd range
2.5 sec cast
Umbral Tin is distinguished from its less impressive cousin by the deep shade of the ore. It resembles the inky black sky. Umbral Tin is more durable yet also more flexible than most other metals.

Drenched in the Sunwell's glow, some ore deposits in Quel'Thalas gleam with incredible radiance. Touching these deposits will release motes of holy energy that burn if caught, but yield additional resources.

Discovery: Midnight Gathering Nodes
